name: e5-modularity-elliptic
question: For each isogeny class of elliptic curves over Q of conductor N <= 1000 in the Cremona database, are the a_p of the curve, from point counts mod p, equal to the a_p of the newform of weight 2 and level N in the aplist of the database, at each prime of the aplist, and for which N do these primes reach the Sturm bound floor(N prod_{p | N} (1 + 1/p) / 6)?
data_source: J. E. Cremona, the Cremona database of elliptic curves, the repository ecdata, https://github.com/JohnCremona/ecdata, read on 2026-11-27 with gh api and the header Accept application/vnd.github.raw, commit 6fedd3ab463a70e52061ebc0b04832ad19fd2e01; licence: The Artistic License 2.0. The README says that the data is available under TheArtistic License 2.0, and LICENSE is the text of The Artistic License 2.0, Copyright (c) 2000-2006, The Perl Foundation. GitHub gives the SPDX id Artistic-2.0
result: agrees: for each of the 2463 classes the a_p of the curve agree with the aplist at all its primes, 61944 in total; for 643 classes these primes reach the Sturm bound, and for the other 1820 the check is partial
